THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
105
STUDY 092
Cream Keyhole Cardigan & Pearls
Rights check
Source: 24978.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark wavy hair and
full bangs sits on a gray sofa with a leopard-print bag
beside her. She wears a cream sheer long-sleeve top
with a button-front cardigan layer and a keyhole center,
with a strand of pearls draped down the front. Her waist
is accented by a black belt with a butterfly buckle, over
a beige satin midi skirt with a quilted texture. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, warm lamp light
and a pale wall. Palette of cream, beige, and warm
black. Romantic and refined, in the style of a soft
interior fashion editorial.
Romantic, refined, soft
WORKING NOTES
- The keyhole front and pearl strand are the signature
details.
- Keep the warm lamp light for a cozy, interior mood.
Try this: Keep the warm lamp light for a cozy interior
mood.
